entries.title: TLS for mobile defenders
entries.summary: TLS authenticates servers and encrypts data in transit.
entries.body: Clients validate certificate chains to trusted CAs. Pinning tightens trust to specific keys/certs but needs a rotation story. User-installed CAs can enable interception on managed/debugging devices — a risk if unexpected.
entries.defense: Treat unexpected cert warnings as blockers. Prefer apps that refuse cleartext.

entries.title: DNS filtering vs VPN privacy
entries.summary: DNS sinkholes block name resolution to known-bad domains; VPNs encrypt tunnels.
entries.body: A local VPN-based DNS filter can sinkhole malicious domains without sending your traffic to a third-party VPN exit. It is not anonymity. Full-tunnel VPNs change path privacy/trust to the VPN operator.
entries.defense: CoreGuard Shield is a local DNS sinkhole style control — use it as a blocklist layer.
